		}

		ai_chance = { base = 95 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_GGR.50 option a"

			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GGR.51 days = 7 }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 1 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_1 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 2 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_2 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 3 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_3 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 4 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_4 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 5 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_5 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 6 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_6 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 7 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_7 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 8 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_8 = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_verh = 9 } } COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_treaty_9 = yes }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_verh = 0 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_verh_prog = 0 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_GER_1970_rv_gui_refresh = yes
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_ratify
	}
	option = {
